gen-gf-goldman-gf-gidole: Gidole draws every stroke like neon tube, with terminals that stay apart like open scissor blades and a midline set high. Goldman above it is wide and commanding, so the two fill a page confidently.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-golos-text: Widely set, parenthesis-round letters give Goldman its swagger, while the heading stays low-slung and bold. And Golos Text fills each line with tall lowercase and one stroke width, approachable and current.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Goldman is wide and bold. Its round forms command attention, while Hedvig Letters Sans does the quieter job, with small letters nearly capital height and a gap left where each c ends.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-heebo: Heebo reads with a tall central band of text and curves that stop short instead of closing in, steady and businesslike. Goldman's wide, bold heading can sit noticeably larger above it.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur has tall lowercase forms like stamped metal type. Over a long page its lines hold their thickness and keep wide gaps where curves meet stems, so Goldman's bold heading stands out clearly.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hind-madurai: Approachable describes Hind Madurai, though Goldman gets the first word with its wide, bold letters. Hind Madurai then follows with s curves open at both ends and lowercase forms that fill the line like capitals.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hind-mysuru: Goldman's lowercase stands big against its capitals, with round forms like open parentheses. Hind Mysuru handles the quieter work, its lowercase pressing close to ascender height, no calligraphic thinning, each a left ajar.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri sets a flat gray hum of constant line weight, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. Hind Siliguri keeps that hum going over a long stretch, while Goldman's wide, commanding letters hold the top.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara has spacious terminal gaps and big open-looking e and a with tall bowls, all in a thickness that never shifts. Goldman's wide, commanding heading gives it a firm contrast.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-huninn: Goldman brings wide, bold letters with round forms like open parentheses, and its lowercase towers over its capitals. And Huninn answers with a rounded-rod, single-weight build, its lowercase rising close to cap height.
